# observation type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:observationType`](gmeow-observationType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/observationType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The kind(s) of observation being made — measurement, sensory reading, standpoint claim, derived inference, etc. Non-functional: an observation may be both a measurement and a derived inference (e.g. a calibrated sensor reading that is also machine-learned), and competing type classifications coexist.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md) -> [`gmeow:ObservationType`](../classes/gmeow-ObservationType.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:observationType`](gmeow-observationType.md) from [`gmeow:Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md) to [`gmeow:ObservationType`](../classes/gmeow-ObservationType.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md), [`gmeow:ObservationType`](../classes/gmeow-ObservationType.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to classify the KIND of observation — measurement, sensory reading, standpoint claim, derived inference, simulation — naming a [`gmeow:ObservationType`](../classes/gmeow-ObservationType.md) individual; non-functional, so a reading that is both measured and machine-derived carries both.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the specific discipline or instrument (that is [`gmeow:observationMethod`](gmeow-observationMethod.md), e.g. radiocarbon dating, GPS survey) and for the producer ([`gmeow:vantage`](gmeow-vantage.md)); the type is the broad category, not the protocol.

### How to use

- Attach one or more [`gmeow:ObservationType`](../classes/gmeow-ObservationType.md) individuals; let the finer sub-discipline ride on [`gmeow:observationMethod`](gmeow-observationMethod.md) and the typed-claim distinction ride on the [`Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md) subclass ([`Measurement`](../classes/gmeow-Measurement.md), [`StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md), [`NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md)).

### Examples

- ex:reading [`gmeow:observationType`](gmeow-observationType.md) [`gmeow:observationTypeMeasurement`](../individuals/gmeow-observationTypeMeasurement.md).
